name: Profane Spell (Metamagic)
body:
You can imbue a spell with evil-aligned energy.

Prerequisites: Knowledge (religion) 1 rank, evil alignment

Benefits: Half the damage of a profane spell is unholy damage, which bypasses any form of energy resistance. Creatures of good alignment suffer a –1 penalty to saving throws against profane spells. A profane spell uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell’s actual level.
